description: This file defines the internal class HistogramBucketAggregator used for collecting and aggregating histogram bucket data within the Orleans runtime diagnostics metrics system.

classes.name: HistogramBucketAggregator
classes.description: A class for aggregating histogram bucket data, maintaining a count and associated tags, and providing collection of the current measurement.

methods.name: HistogramBucketAggregator
methods.description: Constructor initializing tags, bound, and setting up the aggregator.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a measurement value to the current total in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Returns the current measurement as a Measurement<long> object.
